adopted: 2026-10-21, Marathon R13 lane BB (ideas board line 199, Round 11 RB)
attribution: Rule SET only, re-implemented in our own stdlib code in scripts/wiki_cjk_normalise.py. No Vditor or Lute code is copied into either tree, and the Vditor editor itself is NOT adopted. The three source switches are Vditor's preview.markdown options, implemented by Lute: autoSpace, chinesePunct, fixTermTypo. Rule descriptions below are paraphrases of the documented behaviour of those options (Lute README formatting example: CJK-Latin autospace applied in prose, deliberately NOT inside code blocks).
licence: MIT (Vditor and Lute are both MIT-licensed)

rules.description: Insert one ASCII space at a boundary between a CJK character (Han, Hiragana, Katakana, Hangul) and an adjacent Latin letter or digit, in either direction, when no space is present.
rules.name: Space between CJK and Latin/digit runs

rules.description: Remove ASCII spaces immediately before or after fullwidth CJK punctuation (，。！？；：、（）「」『』【】).
rules.name: No space around fullwidth punctuation

rules.description: Convert a halfwidth,.!?;: to its fullwidth form when it is adjacent to a CJK character (the Lute chinesePunct behaviour for Chinese text). Punctuation between two Latin/digit characters is left alone.
rules.name: Halfwidth punctuation to fullwidth in CJK context

rules.description: Convert fullwidth Latin letters and digits (U+FF10-FF19, U+FF21-FF3A, U+FF41-FF5A) to their halfwidth ASCII forms.
rules.name: Fullwidth alphanumeric to halfwidth

rules.description: Lute's fixTermTypo rewrites a fixed dictionary of commonly mistyped technical terms. The dictionary itself was NOT extracted: only the existence of the rule is recorded here. This checker never rewrites terminology.
rules.name: Terminology typo correction

scope: clip/ingest-adjacent text: plain prose lines of clipped or ingested Markdown. Fenced code blocks and inline code spans are never rewritten.
source_project: Vditor (Vanessa219/vditor) and its Lute Markdown engine (88250/lute)
